# FallCube

> A sovereign fractal demonstration. Three flavors showing that the AI-Native Solutions estate composes into itself at every scale. Single HTML file. MIT-licensed. Nothing leaves your device.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-cube/

## What it is

Three demonstrations in one HTML file:

- **A · Cube** — 3D CSS rotating cube with 6 faces, each a live iframe of a fall\* tool. Click to zoom. From inside a zoomed tool, wrap it in a new cube.
- **B · Matryoshka** — Nested doll made of base64 data URIs. Outer embeds inner embeds inner. Whole nested estate travels in one file.
- **C · Reflex** — FallCube opening a copy of FallCube opening a copy of FallCube. Reflexive nesting. Each instance is sovereign.

## Category

Sovereign composition demonstration. Related: single-file HTML, iframe composition, base64 data URIs, self-similar architecture, recursive composition, matryoshka pattern.
